ex.en: I am hungry because I did not eat breakfast.
ex.zh: 我沒吃早餐，所以肚子很餓。

ex.en: I'm pretty hungry. When can we go have lunch?
ex.zh: 我好餓，什麼時候可以去吃午餐？

ex.en: When I got home, I was very hungry.
ex.zh: 我回到家時肚子非常餓。

ex.en: The young team is hungry for success.
ex.zh: 這支年輕的團隊渴望成功。

ex.en: She is hungry for new challenges at work.
ex.zh: 她渴望在工作上接受新挑戰。

ex.en: After the hurricane, their house was a wreck.
ex.zh: 颶風過後，他們的房子成了一片廢墟。

ex.en: The hurricane caused many flights to be cancelled.
ex.zh: 颶風導致許多航班取消。

hurricane.en: a storm with very strong winds and heavy rain

ex.en: Singapore is a major shipping hub.
ex.zh: 新加坡是主要的航運樞紐。

ex.en: The city is a hub for tech start-ups.
ex.zh: 這座城市是科技新創公司的聚集中心。

hub.en: the main place where an activity or system is centered

ex.en: Connect the printer to the USB hub.
ex.zh: 把印表機接到 USB 集線器上。

ex.en: The network hub needs to be replaced.
ex.zh: 網路集線器需要更換。

hub.en: a device that connects several computers or machines together

ex.en: The event was hugely successful.
ex.zh: 這場活動非常成功。

ex.en: Her new book is hugely popular.
ex.zh: 她的新書非常受歡迎。

ex.en: Funding is the biggest hurdle for the project.
ex.zh: 資金是這個專案最大的難關。

ex.en: We cleared the final hurdle and got approval.
ex.zh: 我們通過了最後一道關卡，拿到核准。

hurdle.en: a problem that you must deal with before you can succeed

ex.en: The temperature of the human body hovers around 37°C.
ex.zh: 人體溫度大約在攝氏 37 度上下。

ex.en: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
ex.zh: 不用說，基本人權應該受到尊重。

ex.en: Humans are the only animals that can use fire.
ex.zh: 人類是唯一會用火的動物。

ex.en: People used to think that only humans could use language.
ex.zh: 以前人們認為只有人類會使用語言。

ex.en: It's not possible for humans to live forever.
ex.zh: 人不可能長生不死。

ex.en: He will be a good husband to my sister.
ex.zh: 他會是我妹妹的好丈夫。

ex.en: He's making it clear that he's an ideal husband.
ex.zh: 他擺明了自己是理想的丈夫。

ex.en: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.
ex.zh: 越來越多女性擁有自己的事業，經濟上不必依賴丈夫。

husband.en: the man a woman is married to

ex.en: A huge tanker just pulled out from the dock.
ex.zh: 一艘巨大的油輪剛駛離碼頭。

ex.en: We arrived to find a huge meal ready for us.
ex.zh: 我們到達時，發現一頓豐盛的大餐已經準備好了。

ex.en: The new product was a huge success.
ex.zh: 新產品大獲成功。

ex.en: Roger slipped on the ice and hurt his leg.
ex.zh: 羅傑在冰上滑倒，摔傷了腿。

ex.en: A hundred people were hurt in a train wreck.
ex.zh: 一百人在火車事故中受傷。

hurt.en: to cause injury or pain to a body part

ex.en: If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist.
ex.zh: 如果你牙齒痛，就該去看牙醫。

ex.en: My head hurts. Maybe I should take an aspirin.
ex.zh: 我頭好痛，也許該吃顆阿斯匹靈。

ex.en: My calf has been hurting since yesterday.
ex.zh: 我的小腿從昨天開始一直痛。

hurt.en: to feel pain in a part of the body

ex.en: Afraid of hurting his feelings, I didn't tell him the truth.
ex.zh: 我怕傷了他的心，所以沒告訴他真相。

ex.en: The bad weather hurt sales this month.
ex.zh: 壞天氣影響了本月的銷售。

hurt.en: to make someone feel upset, or to cause harm to something

ex.en: He likes to hunt.
ex.zh: 他喜歡打獵。

ex.en: Tom and Mary went deer hunting.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗去獵鹿了。

hunt.en: to chase and kill animals for food or sport

ex.en: We're hunting for a new apartment.
ex.zh: 我們正在找新公寓。

ex.en: She spent months hunting for a job.
ex.zh: 她花了好幾個月找工作。

ex.en: The job hunt took me six months.
ex.zh: 我找工作找了六個月。

ex.en: The hunt for a new CEO has begun.
ex.zh: 尋找新執行長的工作已經展開。

ex.en: Our teacher has a wonderful sense of humor.
ex.zh: 我們老師非常有幽默感。

ex.en: You have a good sense of humor.
ex.zh: 你很有幽默感。

ex.en: It is a pity that he has no sense of humor.
ex.zh: 可惜他一點幽默感都沒有。

humor.en: the quality of being funny, or the ability to enjoy funny things

ex.en: I didn't agree, but I humored him.
ex.zh: 我並不同意，但還是順著他。

ex.en: Just humor her and say yes.
ex.zh: 就順著她的意思答應吧。

humor.en: to agree with someone to keep them happy

ex.en: I hurried in order to catch the first train.
ex.zh: 我趕著去搭第一班火車。

ex.en: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
ex.zh: 如果你快一點，就能追上他。

ex.en: Don't hurry me. I need time to think.
ex.zh: 別催我，我需要時間想一想。

hurry.en: to move or act quickly, or to make someone do so

ex.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.
ex.zh: 快一點，不然你會趕不上末班車。

ex.en: Hurry up! The movie starts in five minutes.
ex.zh: 快點！電影五分鐘後就開始了。

hurry.en: used to tell someone to go or act faster

hurry.zh: 匆忙、急忙（常用 in a hurry）

ex.en: She was in a hurry to see her father.
ex.zh: 她急著去見她父親。

ex.en: Sorry, I'm in a hurry right now.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我現在趕時間。

ex.en: There's no hurry; you can send it tomorrow.
ex.zh: 不急，你明天再寄就好。

hurry.en: a need to do something quickly

ex.en: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.
ex.zh: 世界上有許多人正在挨餓。

ex.en: Millions of people die of hunger each year.
ex.zh: 每年有數百萬人死於飢餓。

ex.en: Let's eat now. I'm dying of hunger.
ex.zh: 我們現在吃吧，我快餓死了。

hunger.en: the feeling or state of needing food

ex.en: She has a real hunger for success.
ex.zh: 她非常渴望成功。

ex.en: His hunger for knowledge never stopped.
ex.zh: 他對知識的渴求從未停止。

ex.en: Summer in Taipei is very hot and humid!
ex.zh: 台北的夏天又熱又潮濕！

ex.en: Hot and humid weather makes us lazy.
ex.zh: 炎熱潮溼的天氣使我們變得懶散。

ex.en: It is less humid today than it was yesterday.
ex.zh: 今天沒有昨天那麼潮濕。

humid.en: warm and wet in a way that feels uncomfortable

ex.en: The humidity in Taiwan makes summer feel hotter.
ex.zh: 台灣的濕度讓夏天感覺更熱。

ex.en: Today's humidity is about 85%.
ex.zh: 今天的濕度約 85%。

humidity.en: the amount of water in the air

ex.en: Music is a common speech for humanity.
ex.zh: 音樂是人類共通的語言。

ex.en: Cancer is a great enemy of humanity.
ex.zh: 癌症是人類的大敵。

ex.en: Slavery is a crime against humanity.
ex.zh: 奴役制是一種危害人類罪。

humanity.en: all the people in the world

ex.en: The doctor treated every patient with humanity and respect.
ex.zh: 那位醫生以人道和尊重的態度對待每位病人。

ex.en: The soldier showed great humanity toward the prisoners.
ex.zh: 那名士兵對俘虜展現了極大的人道精神。

humanity.en: kindness and care for other people

ex.en: I didn't want to humiliate you.
ex.zh: 我不是想要羞辱你。

ex.en: The coach humiliated the player in front of the whole team.
ex.zh: 教練當著全隊的面羞辱那名球員。

humiliate.en: to make someone feel ashamed in front of others

ex.en: He humorously described his first day at work.
ex.zh: 他幽默地描述自己上班的第一天。

ex.en: The book humorously explains how to survive a family dinner.
ex.zh: 這本書用幽默的筆法說明如何撐過家庭聚餐。

ex.en: He still remembers the humiliation of failing in front of his class.
ex.zh: 他仍記得在全班面前失敗的羞辱。

ex.en: The team suffered a humiliation in a 10-0 defeat.
ex.zh: 球隊以 0 比 10 慘敗，備受羞辱。

humiliation.en: the feeling of being ashamed in front of others

ex.en: Tom and Mary hugged each other.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗互相擁抱。

ex.en: I hugged him tightly and cried.
ex.zh: 我緊緊地抱著他哭。

ex.en: She hugged her son and put him to bed.
ex.zh: 她擁抱了一下兒子，然後讓他上床睡覺。

hug.en: to hold someone tightly in your arms to show love

ex.en: Do you still want to give me a hug?
ex.zh: 你還想擁抱我一下嗎？

ex.en: She gave her best friend a big hug at the airport.
ex.zh: 她在機場給了好朋友一個大大的擁抱。

hug.en: the act of holding someone tightly in your arms

ex.en: "Hurrah! We won the game!" the children shouted.
ex.zh: 孩子們大喊：「好耶！我們贏了！」

ex.en: Hip, hip, hurrah! Happy birthday, Grandma!
ex.zh: 萬歲萬歲！奶奶生日快樂！

hurrah.en: a shout of joy used when something good happens

ex.en: A loud hurrah went up from the crowd when the team scored.
ex.zh: 球隊得分時，群眾爆出一陣歡呼。

ex.en: The news was greeted with hurrahs from the students.
ex.zh: 學生們聽到這個消息都歡呼起來。

hurrah.en: a loud shout of joy or approval

ex.en: There are about a hundred students in the hall.
ex.zh: 大廳裡大約有一百名學生。

ex.en: She is one hundred years old today.
ex.zh: 她今天一百歲了。

ex.en: Hundreds of people waited outside the stadium.
ex.zh: 數以百計的人在體育場外等候。

ex.en: The old temple has hundreds of stone steps.
ex.zh: 這座古廟有數百級石階。

ex.en: Hunting is not allowed in this national park.
ex.zh: 這座國家公園裡禁止打獵。

ex.en: His grandfather enjoyed hunting in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他的祖父喜歡在山裡打獵。

ex.en: Job hunting can be stressful after graduation.
ex.zh: 畢業後找工作可能壓力很大。

ex.en: We spent the weekend house hunting in the suburbs.
ex.zh: 我們整個週末都在郊區找房子。

ex.en: The hunter followed the tracks into the forest.
ex.zh: 獵人沿著足跡走進森林。

ex.en: A hunter found the lost hiker near the river.
ex.zh: 一名獵人在河邊找到了那名走失的登山客。

ex.en: She is a bargain hunter who never pays full price.
ex.zh: 她很會找便宜貨，從不付全額。

ex.en: The company hired a job hunter to look for new talent.
ex.zh: 公司請了一位獵頭來尋找新人才。

ex.en: She has a great sense of humour and always makes us laugh.
ex.zh: 她很有幽默感，總是逗得我們大笑。

ex.en: His dry humour surprised the new colleagues.
ex.zh: 他不動聲色的幽默讓新同事很驚訝。

ex.en: I just nodded to humour him because he was upset.
ex.zh: 他很不高興，我只好點頭順著他。

ex.en: She humoured her little brother by playing his game again.
ex.zh: 她又陪弟弟玩了一次他的遊戲，順著他的意。

ex.en: They spent the night in a small wooden hut on the mountain.
ex.zh: 他們在山上的一間小木屋過夜。

ex.en: A fisherman lives in the hut by the lake.
ex.zh: 一位漁夫住在湖邊的小屋裡。

ex.en: Hugh teaches history at a small college.
ex.zh: 休在一所小型學院教歷史。

ex.en: I borrowed an umbrella from Hugh.
ex.zh: 我向休借了一把雨傘。

huh.zh: 蛤？、咦（沒聽清楚或感到意外）

ex.en: Huh? I didn't catch what you just said.
ex.zh: 蛤？我沒聽到你剛剛說什麼。

ex.en: Huh, that's strange. The door was open a minute ago.
ex.zh: 咦，真奇怪，剛剛門明明是開著的。

ex.en: It's a pretty good idea, huh?
ex.zh: 這個點子不錯，對吧？

ex.en: You forgot your keys again, huh?
ex.zh: 你又忘了帶鑰匙，是吧？

ex.en: Hungary is a country in central Europe.
ex.zh: 匈牙利是中歐的一個國家。

ex.en: Budapest is the capital of Hungary.
ex.zh: 布達佩斯是匈牙利的首都。

ex.en: The country sent humanitarian aid to the flood victims.
ex.zh: 那個國家向洪災受害者提供人道援助。

ex.en: A humanitarian crisis is growing in the region.
ex.zh: 那個地區的人道危機正在擴大。

ex.en: She is a well-known humanitarian who has helped many refugees.
ex.zh: 她是一位知名的人道主義者，幫助過許多難民。

ex.en: The humanitarian spent years working in poor villages.
ex.zh: 那位人道主義者多年來都在貧窮的村莊工作。

ex.en: The hull of the ship was damaged by the ice.
ex.zh: 船體被冰塊撞壞了。

ex.en: Workers painted the hull of the boat white.
ex.zh: 工人把船體漆成白色。

ex.en: Remove the hull from the strawberry before eating it.
ex.zh: 吃草莓前要先把蒂頭摘掉。

ex.en: The hulls of the sunflower seeds covered the ground.
ex.zh: 葵花子的殼撒了一地。

ex.en: Despite his success, he remained humble and kind.
ex.zh: 儘管成功了，他仍然謙虛又親切。

ex.en: She is too humble to talk about her own achievements.
ex.zh: 她太謙虛了，不會談論自己的成就。

ex.en: He grew up in a humble home with no running water.
ex.zh: 他在一個沒有自來水的簡陋家庭長大。

ex.en: They lived a humble life in a small village.
ex.zh: 他們在小村莊過著簡樸的生活。

ex.en: The loss humbled the champion and made him train harder.
ex.zh: 這次落敗讓冠軍學會了謙卑，也讓他更努力訓練。

ex.en: I was humbled by the kindness of strangers.
ex.zh: 陌生人的善意讓我感到自己的渺小而謙卑。

ex.en: We tried a Hungarian soup at the little restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們在小餐館嘗了一道匈牙利湯。

ex.en: The Hungarian capital is Budapest.
ex.zh: 匈牙利的首都是布達佩斯。

ex.en: My neighbor is a Hungarian who moved here ten years ago.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是十年前搬來的匈牙利人。

ex.en: She is learning Hungarian, which she finds very difficult.
ex.zh: 她正在學匈牙利語，覺得非常困難。

ex.en: She likes to hum while she cooks.
ex.zh: 她喜歡邊做菜邊哼歌。

ex.en: The refrigerator hums quietly at night.
ex.zh: 冰箱在夜裡發出安靜的嗡嗡聲。

ex.en: I could hear the hum of the air conditioner.
ex.zh: 我可以聽到冷氣的嗡嗡聲。

ex.en: A low hum came from the machine.
ex.zh: 機器傳出低沉的嗡嗡聲。

ex.en: The boy hurled the ball over the fence.
ex.zh: 男孩把球用力扔過圍牆。

ex.en: She hurled her bag onto the bed and sighed.
ex.zh: 她把包包往床上一扔，嘆了口氣。

ex.en: The two drivers hurled insults at each other across the street.
ex.zh: 兩位駕駛隔著街互相謾罵。

ex.en: He hurled angry words at the referee after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，他對裁判怒吼。

ex.en: The sky turned a deep orange hue at sunset.
ex.zh: 日落時天空變成深橘色調。

ex.en: The paint comes in many hues, from pale blue to dark green.
ex.zh: 這款油漆有許多色調，從淺藍到深綠都有。

ex.en: We huddled under one umbrella in the rain.
ex.zh: 我們在雨中擠在同一把傘下。

ex.en: The kittens huddled together to stay warm.
ex.zh: 小貓們擠在一起取暖。

ex.en: The players formed a huddle before the last play.
ex.zh: 球員們在最後一次攻勢前圍成一圈商量。

ex.en: A huddle of tourists stood around the guide.
ex.zh: 一小群遊客擠在導遊身邊。

hudson.zh: 哈德遜河（美國紐約的河流）

ex.en: The Hudson River flows past New York City.
ex.zh: 哈德遜河流經紐約市。

ex.en: We took a boat trip along the Hudson.
ex.zh: 我們沿著哈德遜河搭船旅行。

ex.en: The shelter promises humane treatment for every animal.
ex.zh: 這間收容所保證善待每一隻動物。

ex.en: Many people want a more humane way to raise chickens.
ex.zh: 許多人希望有更人道的養雞方式。

ex.en: It was the humane thing to do, so we helped him.
ex.zh: 這樣做才合乎人道，所以我們幫了他。

ex.en: He hurriedly packed his bag and ran to the station.
ex.zh: 他匆匆收拾背包，跑向車站。

ex.en: She hurriedly finished her homework before dinner.
ex.zh: 她在晚餐前匆忙寫完了作業。

ex.en: I have a hunch that she will say yes.
ex.zh: 我有種預感，她會答應。

ex.en: He followed his hunch and took the earlier train.
ex.zh: 他憑著直覺搭了較早的那班火車。

ex.en: He hunched over his desk to read the small print.
ex.zh: 他彎著身子趴在桌上看那些小字。

ex.en: She hunched her shoulders against the cold wind.
ex.zh: 她縮起肩膀抵擋寒風。

ex.en: She studies the humanities, including history and literature.
ex.zh: 她研讀人文學科，包括歷史和文學。

ex.en: The college offers many courses in the humanities.
ex.zh: 這所學院開了許多人文學科的課程。

ex.en: I love the hustle and bustle of the city at lunchtime.
ex.zh: 我喜歡午餐時間城市裡熱鬧忙碌的氣氛。

ex.en: She wanted to escape the hustle of the busy airport.
ex.zh: 她想逃離繁忙機場的喧鬧。

ex.en: We had to hustle to catch the last train.
ex.zh: 我們得趕快才能搭上最後一班火車。

ex.en: The guard hustled the visitors out of the building.
ex.zh: 警衛催促訪客離開大樓。

ex.en: He hustles every weekend to earn extra money for tuition.
ex.zh: 他每個週末都拚命打工賺學費。

ex.en: You have to hustle if you want to succeed in this business.
ex.zh: 想在這行成功就得拚命打拚。

ex.en: He gave a humorous speech that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 他發表了一場讓大家都笑了的幽默演說。

ex.en: The book is a humorous story about a clumsy cat.
ex.zh: 這本書是一個關於笨手笨腳的貓的幽默故事。

ex.en: He accepted the award with great humility.
ex.zh: 他非常謙虛地接受了這個獎項。

ex.en: Humility is an important quality in a good leader.
ex.zh: 謙卑是好領導者的重要特質。

ex.en: Losing in front of the whole school was humiliating.
ex.zh: 在全校面前輸掉真是丟臉。

ex.en: He found the public apology humiliating.
ex.zh: 他覺得公開道歉很丟臉。

ex.en: Fire was one of the greatest discoveries in the history of humankind.
ex.zh: 火是人類歷史上最偉大的發現之一。

ex.en: Climate change is a challenge for all humankind.
ex.zh: 氣候變遷是全人類的挑戰。

ex.en: The truck hurtled down the hill without any brakes.
ex.zh: 那輛卡車失去煞車，朝山下疾衝而去。

ex.en: Rocks hurtled past us as we ran.
ex.zh: 我們奔跑時，石頭從身邊呼嘯而過。

ex.en: He cut a hunk of bread from the loaf.
ex.zh: 他從麵包上切下一大塊。

ex.en: A hunk of ice fell from the roof.
ex.zh: 一大塊冰從屋頂掉下來。

ex.en: She hushed the baby with a soft song.
ex.zh: 她用輕柔的歌聲哄寶寶安靜下來。

ex.en: The teacher hushed the class when the principal walked in.
ex.zh: 校長走進來時，老師要全班安靜。

ex.en: A hush fell over the crowd as the singer walked on stage.
ex.zh: 歌手走上舞台時，群眾頓時安靜下來。

ex.en: There was a deep hush in the library.
ex.zh: 圖書館裡一片寂靜。

ex.en: Hush! The baby is finally asleep.
ex.zh: 噓！寶寶終於睡著了。

ex.en: Hush, someone is coming.
ex.zh: 噓，有人來了。

ex.en: A camel stores fat in the hump on its back.
ex.zh: 駱駝把脂肪儲存在背上的駝峰裡。

ex.en: Slow down when you reach the hump in the road.
ex.zh: 開到路上的隆起處要減速。

ex.en: Years of bending over a desk gave him a slight hump.
ex.zh: 多年彎腰伏案讓他有點駝背。

ex.en: The old man walked with a hump in his back.
ex.zh: 老先生駝著背走路。

ex.en: He spoke in a husky voice after the long concert.
ex.zh: 長時間的演唱會後，他說話聲音沙啞。

ex.en: The singer has a warm, husky voice.
ex.zh: 這位歌手的嗓音溫暖而略帶沙啞。

ex.en: Our neighbor has a husky with blue eyes.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居養了一隻藍眼睛的哈士奇。

ex.en: A husky can pull a sled across the snow.
ex.zh: 哈士奇可以拉雪橇穿越雪地。

ex.en: Remove the husk before cooking the corn.
ex.zh: 煮玉米前先剝掉外殼。

ex.en: The rice grains are covered by a hard husk.
ex.zh: 稻穀外面包著一層硬殼。

ex.en: We husked the corn on the porch.
ex.zh: 我們在門廊上剝玉米殼。

ex.en: She husked the nuts one by one.
ex.zh: 她一顆一顆地剝掉堅果的殼。

ex.en: He huffed and left the room without saying a word.
ex.zh: 他氣呼呼地離開房間，一句話也沒說。

ex.en: She huffed up the stairs with a heavy bag.
ex.zh: 她揹著重包包，呼哧呼哧地爬上樓梯。

ex.en: He left in a huff after the argument.
ex.zh: 吵完架後，他怒氣沖沖地走了。

ex.en: She stormed off in a huff when no one listened.
ex.zh: 沒人聽她說話，她氣呼呼地走開了。

ex.en: A hummingbird hovered in front of the red flower.
ex.zh: 一隻蜂鳥懸停在紅花前。

ex.en: The hummingbird is one of the smallest birds in the world.
ex.zh: 蜂鳥是世界上最小的鳥類之一。

ex.en: Renaissance humanism focused on the value of human life and learning.
ex.zh: 文藝復興時期的人文主義重視人的價值與學習。

ex.en: Her essay discusses humanism in modern education.
ex.zh: 她的文章探討現代教育中的人本主義。

ex.en: The library was hushed and calm.
ex.zh: 圖書館安靜而平和。

ex.en: They spoke in hushed voices so they would not wake the baby.
ex.zh: 他們壓低聲音說話，以免吵醒嬰兒。

ex.en: Today is the hundredth day of school.
ex.zh: 今天是開學的第一百天。

ex.en: She celebrated her hundredth birthday with her family.
ex.zh: 她和家人一起慶祝一百歲生日。

humanist.zh: 人文主義者；人道主義者

ex.en: The humanist argued that education should focus on human values.
ex.zh: 那位人文主義者主張教育應該重視人的價值。

ex.en: She is a humanist who believes in kindness without religion.
ex.zh: 她是個人道主義者，相信不靠宗教也能待人良善。

ex.en: The Humber is a large river on the east coast of England.
ex.zh: 亨伯河是英格蘭東海岸的一條大河。

ex.en: A long suspension bridge crosses the Humber.
ex.zh: 一座長長的吊橋橫跨亨伯河。

ex.en: We hunkered down behind the wall to avoid the wind.
ex.zh: 我們蹲在牆後躲風。

ex.en: The hikers hunkered under a rock during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間，登山客蹲在岩石下躲避。

ex.en: The rusting hulk of an old ship lay on the beach.
ex.zh: 一艘生鏽的舊船殘骸躺在海灘上。

ex.en: A huge hulk of a truck blocked the narrow road.
ex.zh: 一輛龐大笨重的卡車擋住了窄路。

ex.en: His hubris led him to ignore his advisers' warnings.
ex.zh: 他的傲慢使他無視顧問們的警告。

ex.en: The company's downfall was caused by its leaders' hubris.
ex.zh: 這家公司的衰敗是因為領導者的狂妄自大。

ex.en: Animal husbandry is an important part of farming.
ex.zh: 畜牧是農業很重要的一部分。

ex.en: She studied husbandry at an agricultural college.
ex.zh: 她在農業學院學習農事與畜牧。

ex.en: Those were hurtful words, and she did not forget them.
ex.zh: 那些話很傷人，她一直沒有忘記。

ex.en: It is hurtful when friends leave you out on purpose.
ex.zh: 朋友故意把你排除在外，是很傷感情的事。

ex.en: The school takes a humanistic approach to education.
ex.zh: 這所學校採取人本主義的教育方式。

ex.en: She studied humanistic psychology at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學修了人本心理學。

ex.en: A hulking truck blocked the narrow street.
ex.zh: 一輛龐大的卡車堵住了窄街。

ex.en: The hulking man ducked to enter the small door.
ex.zh: 那個魁梧的男人彎身走進小門。

ex.en: Hullo, is anyone home?
ex.zh: 哈囉，有人在家嗎？

ex.en: Hullo there! I haven't seen you in ages.
ex.zh: 嗨，好久不見了！

ex.en: "Thank you," she said huskily, trying not to cry.
ex.zh: 「謝謝你，」她聲音沙啞地說，努力不哭出來。

ex.en: He spoke huskily because he had a bad cold.
ex.zh: 他因為重感冒而說話聲音沙啞。

humbling.zh: 令人謙卑的；使人感到卑微的

ex.en: Losing the match was a humbling experience for the champion.
ex.zh: 輸掉比賽對這位冠軍來說是一次令人謙卑的經驗。

ex.en: It was humbling to see how little I really knew.
ex.zh: 看到自己真正懂得這麼少，讓我覺得很謙卑。

ex.en: Visiting the poor village was a humbling trip.
ex.zh: 探訪那個貧困的村莊是一趟令人反思謙卑的旅程。

ex.en: We did everything humanly possible to save the old building.
ex.zh: 我們做了人力所能及的一切來保住那棟老建築。

ex.en: It is not humanly possible to finish this by tomorrow.
ex.zh: 要在明天前完成這件事，人力上是不可能的。

ex.en: The photos helped humanize the story of the refugees.
ex.zh: 這些照片讓難民的故事更有人情味。

ex.en: Adding a personal touch can humanize a large company.
ex.zh: 加入一些個人風格能讓大公司顯得更有人情味。

ex.en: She hurried to the station so she wouldn't miss the train.
ex.zh: 她匆忙趕往車站，以免錯過火車。

ex.en: The students hurried inside when it started to rain.
ex.zh: 開始下雨時，學生們趕緊跑進屋裡。

ex.en: He gave a hurried answer and left the room.
ex.zh: 他倉促地回答後就離開了房間。

ex.en: We had a hurried breakfast before the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會前我們匆匆吃了早餐。

ex.en: He humbly accepted the award and thanked his team.
ex.zh: 他謙虛地接受獎項並感謝他的團隊。

ex.en: She humbly asked for forgiveness.
ex.zh: 她謙卑地請求原諒。

ex.en: Wolves hunted deer in the snowy forest.
ex.zh: 狼群在雪地森林裡獵捕鹿。

ex.en: The police hunted the thief for weeks.
ex.zh: 警方追捕那名小偷好幾週。

ex.en: The man had a hunted look on his face.
ex.zh: 那名男子臉上有一種惶惶不安的神情。

ex.en: The hunted animal ran for cover.
ex.zh: 被追趕的動物跑去找掩護。

ex.en: He wanted to escape his humdrum office job.
ex.zh: 他想擺脫那份單調乏味的辦公室工作。

ex.en: Life in the small town felt humdrum to her.
ex.zh: 她覺得小鎮的生活很平淡無聊。
